articles.title_en: Digital Distractions with Peer Influence: The Impact of Mobile App Usage on Academic and Labor Market Outcomes
articles.title_cn: 具有同伴影响的数字干扰：移动应用程序使用对学术和劳动力市场结果的影响
articles.abstract_en: Concerns about excessive mobile phone use among youth are mounting. We present estimates of behavioral and contextual peer effects, along with comprehensive evidence on how students’ own and their peers’ app usage affect academic performance, physical health, and labor market outcomes. Our analysis draws on administrative data from a Chinese university covering three student cohorts over four years. We exploit random roommate assignments, differential exposure to a policy shock (gaming restrictions for minors), and differential exposure to a discrete event (the introduction of a blockbuster video game) for identification. App usage is contagious: a one s.d. increase in roommates’ in-college app usage raises own usage by 5.8%. High app usage is harmful across all measured outcomes. A one s.d. increase in app usage reduces GPAs by 36.2% of a within-cohort-major s.d. and lowers wages by 2.3%. Roommates’ app usage reduces a student’s GPA and wages through both disruptions and behavioral spillovers, generating a total negative effect that exceeds half the magnitude of the impact from the student’s own app usage. Extending China’s three-hour-per-week gaming restriction for minors to college students would boost their initial wages by 0.9%. High-frequency GPS and app usage data show that heavy app users spend less time in study halls, are more frequently late or absent from class, and get less sleep.
articles.abstract_cn: 对年轻人过度使用手机的担忧日益加剧。我们提供了对行为和同伴影响的估计，以及关于学生自己和同伴的应用程序使用如何影响学业成绩、身体健康和劳动力市场结果的综合证据。我们的分析借鉴了中国大学的行政数据，涵盖三年四年的学生群体。我们利用随机的室友分配、政策冲击的差异暴露（未成年人的游戏限制）以及离散事件的差异暴露（热门视频游戏的推出）来进行识别。应用程序的使用具有传染性：a 一 s.d.室友在大学内应用程序使用量的增加使自己的使用量增加了 5.8%。高应用程序使用率对所有测量结果都是有害的。 A 一 s.d.应用程序使用量的增加会使同组内专业 s.d 的 GPA 降低 36.2%。并将工资降低2.3%。室友的应用程序使用会通过干扰和行为溢出降低学生的 GPA 和工资，产生的总体负面影响超过学生自己的应用程序使用影响程度的一半。将中国对未成年人每周玩游戏的三小时限制扩大到大学生将使他们的初始工资增加0.9%。高频 GPS 和应用程序使用数据显示，大量使用应用程序的用户在自习室花费的时间更少，迟到或缺课的频率更高，睡眠时间也更少。

articles.title_en: Diversifying Society’s Leaders? The Determinants and Causal Effects of Admission to Highly Selective Private Colleges
articles.title_cn: 社会领袖多元化？进入高选择性私立大学的决定因素和因果效应
articles.abstract_en: We use anonymized admissions data from several colleges linked to income tax records and SAT and ACT test scores to study the determinants and causal effects of attending Ivy-Plus colleges (Ivy League, Stanford, MIT, Duke, and Chicago). Children from families in the top 1% are more than twice as likely to attend an Ivy-Plus college as those from middle-class families with comparable SAT/ACT scores. Two-thirds of this gap is due to higher admission rates for students with comparable test scores from high-income families; the remaining third is due to differences in rates of application and matriculation. In contrast, children from high-income families have no admissions advantage at flagship public colleges. The high-income admissions advantage at Ivy-Plus colleges is driven by three factors: (i) preferences for children of alumni, (ii) weight placed on nonacademic credentials, and (iii) athletic recruitment. Using a new research design that isolates idiosyncratic variation in admissions decisions for waitlisted applicants, we show that attending an Ivy-Plus college instead of the average flagship public college increases students’ chances of reaching the top 1% of the earnings distribution by 50%, nearly doubles their chances of attending an elite graduate school, and almost triples their chances of working at a prestigious firm. The three factors that give children from high-income families an admissions advantage are uncorrelated or negatively correlated with postcollege outcomes, whereas academic credentials such as SAT/ACT scores are highly predictive of postcollege success.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用来自几所大学的匿名录取数据，这些数据与所得税记录以及 SAT 和 ACT 考试成绩相关，来研究就读常春藤+大学（常春藤盟校、斯坦福大学、麻省理工学院、杜克大学和芝加哥大学）的决定因素和因果效应。与 SAT/ACT 成绩相当的中产阶级家庭的孩子相比，来自顶尖 1% 家庭的孩子进入常春藤大学的可能性是后者的两倍多。 二-这一差距的三分之一是由于来自高收入家庭的具有可比考试成绩的学生的录取率较高；剩下的第三是由于申请率和入学率的差异造成的。相比之下，高收入家庭的孩子在旗舰公立大学没有入学优势。常春藤+大学的高收入录取优势是由三因素驱动的：（i）对校友子女的偏好，（ii）对非学术证书的重视，以及（iii）体育招生。我们使用一种新的研究设计，隔离了候补申请者录取决策中的特殊差异，结果表明，就读常春藤+大学而不是普通的旗舰公立大学，学生达到收入分配顶端1%的机会增加了50%，进入精英研究生院的机会几乎增加了一倍，在著名公司工作的机会几乎增加了三倍。为高收入家庭的孩子提供入学优势的因素与大学毕业后的成绩不相关或负相关，而 SAT/ACT 成绩等学术证书可以高度预测大学毕业后的成功。

articles.abstract_en: Why do banks fail? We create a panel covering most commercial banks from 1863 through 2024 to study the history of failing banks in the United States. Failing banks are characterized by rising asset losses, deteriorating solvency, and an increasing reliance on expensive noncore funding. These commonalities imply that bank failures are highly predictable using simple accounting metrics from publicly available financial statements. Failures with runs were common before deposit insurance, but these failures are strongly related to weak fundamentals, casting doubt on the importance of non-fundamental runs. Furthermore, low recovery rates on failed banks’ assets suggest that most failed banks subject to runs were fundamentally insolvent, barring large value destruction of receiverships. Altogether, our evidence suggests that the primary cause of bank failures and banking crises is almost always and everywhere a deterioration of bank fundamentals.
articles.abstract_cn: 银行为何倒闭？我们创建了一个涵盖从1863到2024的大多数商业银行的小组来研究美国银行倒闭的历史。破产银行的特点是资产损失增加、偿付能力恶化以及对昂贵的非核心资金的依赖日益增加。这些共性意味着，使用公开财务报表中的简单会计指标，银行倒闭是高度可预测的。在存款保险出现之前，挤兑失败很常见，但这些失败与基本面疲软密切相关，这让人们对非基本面挤兑的重要性产生了怀疑。此外，破产银行资产的回收率较低，这表明大多数遭受挤兑的破产银行基本上已经资不抵债，除非破产管理权遭受重大价值损失。总而言之，我们的证据表明，银行倒闭和银行危机的主要原因几乎在任何地方都是银行基本面的恶化。

articles.title_en: Traditional Institutions in Modern Times: Dowries as Pensions When Sons Migrate
articles.title_cn: 现代社会中的传统制度：儿子迁移时，嫁妆如何充当养老金
articles.abstract_en: This paper uses newly collected data on the allocation of dowry to examine its role in resolving intergenerational frictions around migration in India. Migration disrupts traditional elderly support structures, in which sons live near their parents and care for them in old age. We develop a model in which dowry can promote migration by allowing sons to make upfront transfers to their parents and ease constraints on income sharing. To test this hypothesis, we collect two new data sets that measure the distribution of dowry between family members. We document for the first time that net transfers of dowry to a man’s parents are common but far from universal. Consistent with using dowry for income sharing, such transfers occur more often when sons migrate, especially when they work in higher-earning occupations. In nationally representative data, migration rates are higher in areas with stronger historical dowry traditions. Finally, exploiting a large-scale highway construction program, we show that men from areas with stronger historical dowry traditions migrate more when migration costs fall. Our findings provide some clues as to why dowry persists despite its well-documented adverse consequences.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用新收集的嫁妆分配数据，考察嫁妆在缓解印度家庭因迁移产生的代际摩擦方面所发挥的作用。迁移会打破传统的养老支持结构；在这一结构中，儿子居住在父母附近，并在父母年老时照料他们。我们构建了一个模型，说明嫁妆可以让儿子预先向父母转移资源、缓解收入分享约束，从而促进迁移。为检验这一假说，我们收集了两套新数据，用于衡量嫁妆在家庭成员之间的分配。研究首次记录到，嫁妆净转移给男方父母的现象较为常见，但远非普遍。与嫁妆被用于分享收入的解释一致，当儿子迁移时，这类转移更为常见；当儿子从事收入较高的职业时尤其如此。在全国代表性数据中，历史上嫁妆传统较强的地区迁移率更高。最后，利用一项大规模公路建设计划，我们发现，当迁移成本下降时，来自历史嫁妆传统较强地区的男性迁移得更多。研究结果为嫁妆为何在其负面后果已有充分记录的情况下仍然延续提供了一些线索。

articles.title_en: Enlightenment Ideals and Belief in Progress in the Run-up to the Industrial Revolution: A Textual Analysis
articles.title_cn: 工业革命前夕的启蒙理想和进步信念：文本分析
articles.abstract_en: We trace the evolution of the language of science, religion, and political economy in the centuries leading to the British Industrial Revolution. Using textual analysis of 264,443 works printed in England between 1500 and 1900, we test whether British culture manifested a belief in progress associated with science and industry. Our analysis yields three main findings. First, there was a separation in the languages of science and religion beginning in the mid-eighteenth century. Second, volumes using language at the nexus of science and political economy became more progress-oriented during the Enlightenment. Third, volumes using industrial language—especially those at the science-political economy nexus—were more progress-oriented beginning in the eighteenth century.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们追溯了英国工业革命之前的几个世纪里科学、宗教和政治经济学语言的演变。通过对 264,443 和 1500 期间英国印刷的 1900 作品进行文本分析，我们测试了英国文化是否表现出对与科学和工业相关的进步的信念。我们的分析得出了三主要发现。 第一，从十八世纪中叶开始，科学语言和宗教语言出现了分离。 第二，在启蒙运动期间，使用科学和政治经济学联系语言的书籍变得更加以进步为导向。 第三，使用工业语言的书籍——尤其是那些涉及科学与政治经济关系的书籍——在十八世纪开始更加注重进步。

articles.title_en: Bargaining and Inequality in the Labor Market
articles.title_cn: 劳动力市场的讨价还价和不平等
articles.abstract_en: We use novel surveys of firms and workers, linked to administrative employer-employee data, to study the prevalence and importance of individual bargaining in wage determination. We show that simple survey questions accurately elicit firms’ bargaining strategies. Using the elicited strategies for 772 German firms, we document that the majority of firms are willing to engage in individual wage bargaining. Labor market factors predict firms’ strategies better than firm characteristics. Survey responses from nearly 10,000 full-time workers indicate that most workers provide their salary expectations before they receive a job offer. Most outside offers are rejected, with the worker remaining at the incumbent firm. There is substantial heterogeneity in workers’ bargaining behavior, which translates into within-firm wage inequality. Firms that set pay via individual bargaining have a 3 percentage point higher gender wage gap.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用对企业和工人的新颖调查，与行政雇主-雇员数据相联系，来研究个人谈判在工资决定中的普遍性和重要性。我们表明，简单的调查问题可以准确地引出企业的讨价还价策略。使用772德国公司的引出策略，我们发现大多数公司愿意参与个人工资谈判。劳动力市场因素比企业特征更能预测企业战略。近 10,000 名全职工人的调查回复表明，大多数工人在收到工作机会之前都会提供他们的薪资期望。大多数外部报价都被拒绝，员工留在了现任公司。工人的讨价还价行为存在很大的异质性，这会转化为公司内部的工资不平等。通过个人谈判设定薪酬的公司的性别工资差距要高 3 个百分点。

articles.title_en: Who’s Afraid of the Minimum Wage? Measuring the Impacts on Independent Businesses Using Matched U.S. Tax Returns
articles.title_cn: 谁害怕最低工资？使用匹配的美国纳税申报表衡量对独立企业的影响
articles.abstract_en: A common concern surrounding minimum wage policies is their impact on independent businesses, which are often feared to be less able to bear or pass on cost increases. We examine how these typically small and medium-size firms accommodate minimum wage increases along product and labor market margins using a matched owner-firm-worker panel data set drawn from the universe of U.S. tax records over a 10-year period, and using state minimum wage changes as identifying variation. We find that on average, firms in highly exposed industries do not substantially reduce employment—they do not lay off workers but moderately reduce part-time hiring. Instead, these firms are able to fully finance the new labor costs with new revenues, leaving average owner profits unchanged. Higher wage floors, however, forestall entry, particularly for less productive firms, reducing the number of independent firms operating in these industries by roughly 2%. Yet these industries do not shrink; instead, incumbent responses and strong positive selection among entrants reshape industries that rely heavily on low-wage workers, yielding fewer but more productive firms after the cost shock. We also take a worker-level perspective to examine how potentially vulnerable individuals are affected by minimum wage increases. Using panels of low-earning and young workers, we find that their average earnings rise substantially with the minimum wage, while they are no less likely to be employed. Worker transitions indicate that minimum wage increases boost retention and that worker reallocation from independent firms toward corporations buffers disemployment impacts from reduced hiring at independent firms.
articles.abstract_cn: 围绕最低工资政策的一个普遍担忧是其对独立企业的影响，人们常常担心独立企业承受或转嫁成本上涨的能力较差。我们使用从10年期间美国税务记录中提取的匹配的所有者-公司-工人面板数据集，并使用州最低工资变化作为识别变化，研究了这些典型的中小型企业如何适应产品和劳动力市场利润的最低工资增长。我们发现，平均而言，高风险行业的企业不会大幅减少就业——它们不会裁员，但会适度减少兼职招聘。相反，这些公司能够用新的收入来充分支付新的劳动力成本，从而保持平均所有者利润不变。然而，较高的工资下限会阻止进入，特别是对于生产率较低的企业而言，从而使这些行业中运营的独立企业数量减少大约2%。然而，这些行业并没有萎缩，而是不断萎缩。相反，现有的应对措施和进入者之间强有力的积极选择重塑了严重依赖低工资工人的行业，在成本冲击后产生了更少但生产率更高的企业。我们还从工人的角度来研究潜在的弱势群体如何受到最低工资上涨的影响。通过对低收入工人和年轻工人的调查，我们发现他们的平均收入随着最低工资的提高而大幅上升，而他们的就业可能性并没有降低。工人的转变表明，最低工资的提高可以提高保留率，而工人从独立公司向企业的重新分配可以缓冲独立公司招聘减少带来的失业影响。

articles.abstract_en: This article studies the returns to enrolling in U.S. public universities by comparing the long-term outcomes of barely admitted versus barely rejected applicants. I use administrative admission records spanning all 35 public universities in Texas, which collectively enroll 10% of all American public university students, to systematically identify and employ decentralized cutoffs in SAT/ACT scores that generate discontinuities in admission and enrollment. The typical marginally admitted student gains an additional year of education in the four-year sector, becomes 12 percentage points more likely to ever earn a bachelor’s degree, and eventually earns 8% more than their marginally rejected but otherwise identical counterpart. Marginally admitted students pay no additional tuition costs thanks to offsetting grant aid; cost-benefit calculations show internal rates of return of 26% for the marginal students themselves, 16% for society (which must pay for the additional education), and 7% for the government budget. Earnings gains are similar across admitting institutions of varying selectivity, but smaller for students from low-income families, who spend more time enrolled but complete fewer degrees and major in less lucrative fields. Finally, I develop a method to separately identify effects for students on the extensive margin of attending any university versus those on the margin of attending a more selective one, revealing larger effects on the extensive margin.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过比较勉强录取和勉强拒绝的申请者的长期结果，研究美国公立大学的入学回报。我使用德克萨斯州所有 35 公立大学的行政录取记录（这些大学总共招收了所有美国公立大学学生的 10%），系统地识别和采用 SAT/ACT 分数中分散的截止点，这些截止点会导致入学和入学的不连续性。典型的被勉强录取的学生在四年级中获得额外一年的教育，获得学士学位的可能性提高12个百分点，并且最终比被勉强录取但其他方面相同的同行获得更多8%的收入。由于抵消助学金，勉强录取的学生无需支付额外的学费；成本效益计算显示，边缘学生本身的内部回报率为26%，社会（必须支付额外教育费用）的内部回报率为16%，政府预算的内部回报率为7%。不同选择性的录取院校的收入增长相似，但对于来自低收入家庭的学生来说，收入增长较小，他们花更多的时间入学，但完成的学位较少，并且主修利润较低的领域。最后，我开发了一种方法来分别确定学生对就读任何大学的广泛边缘的影响与那些对就读更有选择性的大学的边缘的影响，揭示了对广泛边缘的更大影响。

articles.title_en: Republican Support and Economic Hardship: The Enduring Effects of the Opioid Epidemic
articles.title_cn: 共和党的支持和经济困难：阿片类药物流行的持久影响
articles.abstract_en: In this article, we establish a causal connection between two of the most salient social developments in the United States over the past decades: the opioid epidemic and the political realignment between the Republican and Democratic parties. Drawing on unsealed records from litigation against Purdue Pharma, we uncover rich geographic variation in the marketing of prescription opioids that serves as a quasi-exogenous source of exposure to the epidemic. We use this variation to document significant increases in drug-related mortality and greater reliance on public transfer programs. This induced economic hardship led to substantial changes in the political landscape of the communities most affected by the opioid epidemic. We estimate that from the mid-2000s to 2022, exposure to the opioid epidemic continuously increased the Republican vote share in House, presidential, and gubernatorial elections. By the 2022 House elections, a one-standard-deviation increase in our measure of exposure led to a 4.5 percentage point increase in the Republican vote share. From 2012 until 2022, this increase in the House vote share translated into Republicans winning additional seats.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们在过去几十年来美国最显着的社会发展二之间建立了因果关系：阿片类药物的流行与共和党和民主党之间的政治重组。根据针对普渡制药公司诉讼的未密封记录，我们发现处方阿片类药物营销中存在丰富的地理差异，这是该流行病的准外源性暴露来源。我们利用这种变化来记录与毒品相关的死亡率的显着增加以及对公共转移计划的更大依赖。这种引发的经济困难导致受阿片类药物流行影响最严重的社区的政治格局发生了重大变化。我们估计，从2000中期到2022，阿片类药物流行的暴露持续增加了共和党在众议院、总统和州长选举中的选票份额。到 2022 众议院选举时，我们的风险敞口衡量标准的 一 标准差增加导致共和党选票份额增加 4.5 个百分点。从2012到2022，众议院投票份额的增加转化为共和党赢得了更多席位。

articles.title_en: The Price of Housing in the United States, 1890–2006
articles.abstract_en: We construct the first annual market rent and home sales price series for American cities over the twentieth century using 2.7 million newspaper real estate listings. Our findings revise several stylized facts about U.S. housing markets. Real market rents did not fall during the postwar period in most cities and rose nationally by 60% from 1890 to 2006. We also document higher sales price growth between 1953 and 1987 relative to previous series. Real prices reached almost four times their 1890 level by 2006. Prices grew most in metros with high demand and low levels of construction. We find that the rent-to-price ratio fell from about 8% in the early twentieth century to 3% by 2006, consistent with declines in the cost of owning housing relative to renting. For the typical year in our period, the annual return to owning housing was 9%, driven mostly by rental returns of 7.7%, with capital gains contributing only 1.3%. While capital gains were close to zero from 1890 to 1940, they grew to nearly a third of total returns from 1970 to 2006.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用 2.7 百万 报纸房地产列表构建了二十世纪美国城市的 第一 年度市场租金和房屋销售价格系列。我们的研究结果修正了有关美国房地产市场的几个典型事实。战后时期，大多数城市的实际市场租金并未下降，并且从60%到1890在全国范围内上涨了2006。我们还记录了 1953 和 1987 之间相对于之前系列的更高的销售价格增长。到1890实际价格几乎达到2006水平的四倍。需求高、建设水平低的地铁价格涨幅最大。我们发现，租金价格比从二十世纪初的约8%下降到3%的2006，这与拥有住房相对于租赁成本的下降一致。在我们这个时期的典型年份中，拥有住房的年回报率为 9%，主要由 7.7% 的租金回报驱动，资本收益仅贡献 1.3%。虽然从1890到1940资本收益接近零，但从1970到2006它们增长到接近总回报的第三。

articles.title_en: Dollar Dominance and the Transmission of Monetary Policy
articles.title_cn: 美元主导地位与货币政策的传导
articles.abstract_en: Has the dominance of the dollar in global trade rendered monetary policy ineffective? An emerging view contends that if a country invoices its exports in dollars, exchange rates cannot stabilize economic activity, as the classical expenditure-switching channel is muted. This view rests on the premise that export prices are sticky in dollars, breaking the link between export demand and depreciations. But this assumption is not borne out by the data: goods priced in dollars tend to have more flexible prices, along with higher elasticities of substitution. We propose a model with more realistic assumptions and show that even with dollar pricing, depreciating the currency by loosening monetary policy can still boost exports and activity materially. The limit to any expansion is not demand, but supply capacity. We also show that low exchange rate pass-through to dollar prices is not informative about price stickiness. The price response to exchange rates is small when demand elasticities are high, even with flexible prices: low pass-through is an equilibrium result, not evidence of a nominal friction.
articles.abstract_cn: 美元在全球贸易中的主导地位是否导致货币政策失效？一种新的观点认为，如果一个国家以美元为其出口发票，汇率就无法稳定经济活动，因为传统的支出转换渠道被抑制。这种观点的前提是出口价格以美元计价具有粘性，从而打破了出口需求与贬值之间的联系。但数据并没有证实这一假设：以美元计价的商品往往具有更灵活的价格，以及更高的替代弹性。我们提出了一个具有更现实假设的模型，并表明即使以美元定价，通过放松货币政策使货币贬值仍然可以实质性地促进出口和活动。任何扩张的限制不是需求，而是供给能力。我们还表明，低汇率对美元价格的传导并不能提供有关价格粘性的信息。当需求弹性较高时，即使价格灵活，价格对汇率的反应也较小：低传导率是均衡结果，而不是名义摩擦的证据。

articles.title_en: Permanent Capital Losses after Banking Crises
articles.title_cn: 银行业危机后的永久性资本损失
articles.abstract_en: We study the mechanisms driving bank losses across historical banking crises in 46 economies and the effectiveness of policy interventions in restoring bank capitalization. We find that bank stocks experience large, permanent declines at the onset of crises. These losses predict commensurate long-term declines in banks’ earnings and dividends, rather than elevated future equity returns. Bank losses are primarily driven by write-downs of nonperforming assets, not asset sales during panics. Forceful liquidity-based interventions during crises predict only small, temporary increases in bank market value. Overall, these results suggest that bank losses during crises are not primarily due to temporary price dislocations. Early liquidity interventions can avert banking crises, but only under specific conditions. Once large bank equity declines have occurred, policy responses have historically failed to prevent persistent undercapitalization in the banking sector.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了46经济体历史银行危机中导致银行损失的机制以及政策干预在恢复银行资本方面的有效性。我们发现，银行股在危机爆发时会经历大幅、永久性的下跌。这些损失预示着银行盈利和股息的长期相应下降，而不是未来股票回报率的上升。银行损失主要是由不良资产减记造成的，而不是恐慌期间的资产出售。危机期间基于流动性的强有力的干预措施只会导致银行市值出现小幅、暂时的增长。总体而言，这些结果表明，危机期间银行的损失并非主要是由于暂时的价格混乱造成的。早期流动性干预可以避免银行业危机，但只能在特定条件下进行。从历史上看，一旦银行股本大幅下跌，政策应对措施就无法阻止银行业持续资本不足。

articles.title_en: Political Foundations of Racial Violence in the Post-Reconstruction South
articles.title_cn: 重建后南方种族暴力的政治基础
articles.abstract_en: Election results act as powerful signals, shaping social behavior in ways that can be dramatic and even violent. This article shows how racial violence in the post-Reconstruction U.S. South was tied to the local performance of the anti-Black Democratic Party in presidential elections. Using a regression discontinuity design based on close presidential vote shares, we find that Southern counties where Democrats lost the popular vote between 1880 and 1900 were nearly twice as likely to experience Black lynchings in the following four years. Despite no corresponding changes in local office holding, these defeats were salient among local elites. We show that Southern newspapers, closely aligned with the Democratic Party, amplified narratives of Black criminality in the aftermath of Democratic losses. Such accusations were, in turn, frequently invoked by lynch mobs. These findings point to the strategic use of racial violence by Democratic elites, foreshadowing the institutionalized vote suppression of Jim Crow.
articles.abstract_cn: 选举结果是强有力的信号，以戏剧性甚至暴力的方式塑造社会行为。本文展示了重建后的美国南部的种族暴力如何与反黑人民主党在总统选举中的当地表现联系在一起。使用基于接近的总统选票份额的回归不连续性设计，我们发现民主党在1880和1900之间失去普选的南部县在接下来的四年里经历黑人私刑的可能性几乎是其两倍。尽管地方公职没有发生相应的变化，但这些失败在地方精英中尤为突出。我们发现，与民主党关系密切的南方报纸在民主党失败后夸大了黑人犯罪行为的叙述。反过来，此类指控也经常被私刑暴徒援引。这些发现表明民主党精英战略性地使用种族暴力，预示着制度化的吉姆·克劳投票压制。

articles.title_en: Vanguard: Black Veterans and Civil Rights After World War I
articles.title_cn: 先锋：第一次世界大战后的黑人退伍军人和民权
articles.abstract_en: Nearly 400,000 Black men were drafted into the National Army during World War I, where they toiled primarily as menial laborers in segregated units. Leveraging novel variation from the World War I draft lottery and millions of digitized military and NAACP records, we document the pioneering role these men played in the early civil rights movement. Relative to observably similar individuals from the same draft board, Black men randomly inducted into the Army were significantly more likely to join the nascent NAACP and become prominent community leaders in the New Negro era. We find little evidence that these effects are explained by migration or improved socioeconomic status. Rather, corroborating historical accounts about the catalyzing influence of institutional racism in the military, we show that increased civic activism was driven by soldiers who experienced the most discriminatory treatment while serving their country.
articles.abstract_cn: 第一次世界大战期间，近400,000黑人被征召入伍，他们主要在隔离部队中充当卑微的劳工。利用第一次世界大战抽签的新颖变化以及数以百万计的数字化军事和全国有色人种协进会记录，我们记录了这些人在早期民权运动中发挥的先锋作用。与来自同一征兵委员会的明显相似的个人相比，随机入伍的黑人更有可能加入新生的全国有色人种协进会并成为新黑人时代杰出的社区领袖。我们发现几乎没有证据表明这些影响可以用移民或社会经济地位的改善来解释。相反，我们证实了关于军队中制度性种族主义催化影响的历史记载，表明公民活动的增加是由在为国家服务时经历最歧视性待遇的士兵推动的。

articles.title_en: Ideas Have Consequences: The Impact of Law and Economics on American Justice
articles.title_cn: 想法有后果：法律和经济学对美国司法的影响
articles.abstract_en: This article empirically studies the effects of the early law and economics movement on the U.S. judiciary. We focus on the Manne Economics Institute for Federal Judges, an intensive economics course that trained almost half of federal judges between 1976 and 1999. Using the universe of published opinions in U.S. Circuit Courts and 1 million District Court criminal sentencing decisions, we estimate the within-judge effect of Manne program attendance. Selection into attendance was limited, as the program was popular among judges of all backgrounds, frequently oversubscribed, and admitted participants on a first-come, first-served basis. We find that after attending economics training, participating judges use more economics language in their opinions, rule against regulatory agencies more often, and impose more severe criminal sentences. We argue that economics, as a rigorous social science, was especially effective in persuading judges.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文实证研究了早期法律和经济运动对美国司法部门的影响。我们重点关注联邦法官曼恩经济学院，这是一门强化经济学课程，在1976和1999之间培训了几乎一半的联邦法官。利用美国巡回法院发表的大量意见和 1 百万 地方法院的刑事量刑决定，我们估计了曼恩计划出勤的法官内部影响。参加人数的选择是有限的，因为该计划在各种背景的评委中都很受欢迎，经常超额认购，并且以第一来，第一服务的方式录取参与者。我们发现，参加经济学培训后，参与的法官在意见中使用更多的经济学语言，更频繁地对监管机构作出裁决，并判处更严厉的刑事判决。我们认为，经济学作为一门严谨的社会科学，在说服法官方面尤其有效。
